purpose: UI feedback only; no idle pulsing or gameplay-sized explosions

helpSent.path: quadratic arc from Help button to the new filled slot
helpSent.arrival: 3 tiny TA_Stat_star sprites, 120-220 ms outward motion and fade
helpSent.counter: use authoritative response; never predict success

requestPosted.effect: new card fades and rises 12 reference units into feed

collect.effect: small heart lift and settle at existing lives/bank widget; use actual visible destination or local check if header hidden
collect.amount: server-granted count only; no visual credit before confirmation

reducedMotion.effect: crossfade/check only; no travel, scale bounce, particles or vibration

sound: reuse approved UI success sound if available; honor existing sound setting; no audio supplied
